translations.literal: On renchen an edict ordered that in the Two Capitals and the Five Prefectures one assistant prefect and one administrative aide each be reduced; among the six bureau review clerks only the Household and Law bureaus be retained; the rest, together with observation envoys of the various prefectures and frontier judges, all be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ordered that in the Two Capitals and the Five Prefectures one assistant prefect and one administrative aide each be reduced. Among the six bureau review clerks only the Household and Law bureaus would be retained; the rest, together with observation envoys of the various prefectures and frontier judges, would all be reduced.

sentences.zh: 甲午，帝狩於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鄧州劉重進移鎮邠州，滑州宋延渥移鎮鄧州，以前河中節度使王仁鎬為邢州節度使，以邢州留後陳思讓為滑州留後。

translations.literal: On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was made Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang was made Hua Prefecture acting military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was appointed Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang was appointed Hua Prefecture acting military governor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔翰林學士，今後逐日起居，當直者仍赴晚朝。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict ordered that Hanlin academicians henceforth attend daily court; those on duty should still attend the evening audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict ordered that Hanlin academicians henceforth attend daily court and that those on duty should still attend the evening audience.

sentences.zh: 是月，江南李景殺其臣偽太傅中書令宋齊丘、偽兵部侍郎陳覺、偽鎮南軍節度副使李徵古等。

translations.literal: That month Li Jing of Jiangnan killed his ministers the rebel-appointed Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister Song Qiqiu, rebel-appointed Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, rebel-appointed Pacifying South Army deputy military governor Li Zhenggu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Jing of Jiangnan killed his ministers the illegitimately styled Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister Song Qiqiu, illegitimately styled Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, illegitimately styled Pacifying South Army deputy military governor Li Zhenggu, and others.

sentences.zh: 初，帝之南征也，吳人大懼，覺與徵古皆齊丘門人，因進說於景，請委國事於齊丘，景繇是銜之。

translations.literal: Initially, when the emperor campaigned south, the Wu people were greatly afraid; Jue and Zhenggu were both disciples of Qiqiu and therefore advanced a proposal to Jing to entrust state affairs to Qiqiu; Jing thereby harbored resentment against him.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when the emperor campaigned south, the Wu people were greatly afraid. Jue and Zhenggu were both disciples of Qiqiu and therefore urged Jing to entrust state affairs to Qiqiu. Jing thereby harbored resentment against him.

sentences.zh: 及吳人遣鐘謨、李德明奉表至行在，帝尋遣德明復命於金陵，德明因說李景請割江南之地求和於我，而陳覺、李徵古等以德明為賣國，請戮之，景遂殺德明。

translations.literal: When the Wu people sent Zhong Mo and Li Deming to present a memorial at the mobile court, the emperor soon sent Deming back to report at Jinling; Deming therefore urged Li Jing to cede Jiangnan territory and seek peace with us; but Chen Jue, Li Zhenggu, and others regarded Deming as selling out the state and requested his execution; Jing then killed Deming.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wu people sent Zhong Mo and Li Deming to present a memorial at the field headquarters, the emperor soon sent Deming back to report at Jinling. Deming therefore urged Li Jing to cede Jiangnan territory and seek peace with the Zhou court. But Chen Jue, Li Zhenggu, and others regarded Deming as selling out the state and requested his execution, and Jing then killed Deming.

sentences.zh: 及江南內附，帝放鐘謨南歸，謨本德明之黨也，因譖齊丘等，故齊丘等得罪。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan submitted internally, the emperor released Zhong Mo to return south; Mo had originally been of Deming's faction and therefore slandered Qiqiu and the others, so Qiqiu and the others were punished.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan submitted to the court, the emperor released Zhong Mo to return south. Mo had originally been of Deming's faction and therefore slandered Qiqiu and the others, and Qiqiu and the others were punished.

sentences.zh: 放齊丘歸九華山，覺等貶官，尋並害之。

translations.literal: Qiqiu was released to return to Mount Jiuhua; Jue and others were demoted in office, and soon all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqiu was released to Mount Jiuhua; Jue and others were demoted, and soon all were killed.

sentences.zh: 景既誅齊丘等，令鐘謨到闕，具言其事，故書。

translations.literal: After Jing had executed Qiqiu and the others, he ordered Zhong Mo to come to court and fully report the matter; hence this record.
translations.idiomatic: After Jing had executed Qiqiu and the others, he ordered Zhong Mo to come to court and fully report the matter; hence this record.
